avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin D supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Octreotide inhibits growth hormone and may impair calcium absorption; concurrent high-dose vitamin D supplementation may cause hypercalcemia or electrolyte imbalances
avoid_supplements.action: Monitor calcium and phosphate levels; use only standard-dose vitamin D under physician supervision

avoid_supplements.name: Corticosteroid supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Octreotide suppresses growth hormone and multiple hormones; corticosteroids may mask symptoms of adrenal insufficiency or increase adverse effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use without endocrinology oversight; monitor HPA axis function

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Octreotide may impair nutrient absorption in GI tract; iron absorption could be reduced
caution_supplements.action: Space dosing 2+ hours apart; monitor hemoglobin and ferritin levels

caution_supplements.name: Fat-soluble vitamin supplements (A, E, K)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Octreotide reduces fat absorption and may decrease bioavailability of lipophilic vitamins
caution_supplements.action: Monitor fat-soluble vitamin levels periodically; consider water-soluble alternatives if needed

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Octreotide significantly reduces fat absorption and slows GI transit; high-fat intake increases risk of steatorrhea, malabsorption, and GI distress
avoid_foods.action: Maintain low-fat diet (<25-30g fat daily); counsel on dietary modifications

caution_foods.name: Calcium-rich foods (dairy, leafy greens)
caution_foods.mechanism: Octreotide impairs calcium and fat-soluble vitamin absorption; excessive intake may not be absorbed effectively and could affect bone health
caution_foods.action: Monitor dietary calcium intake; assess serum calcium and bone markers during long-term therapy

caution_foods.name: Protein-rich meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Octreotide slows gastric emptying and may reduce protein absorption; large protein loads could worsen GI symptoms
caution_foods.action: Distribute protein intake throughout day in moderate portions; monitor nutritional status

monitoring_notes: Monitor electrolytes (sodium, potassium), glucose, vitamin B12, fat-soluble vitamins, and bone density during long-term octreotide therapy, as malabsorption and metabolic effects are common. Assess for steatorrhea, GI symptoms, and nutritional deficiencies at regular intervals.
